The post is titled "We are not on track to meet the 1.5°C goal" and discusses climate change statistics according to the Climate Action Tracker. It states that only two countries, Morocco and The Gambia, are on track to meet the 1.5°C upper limit, while most countries, including all EU members, are currently on track for a 3°C increase or more.
